India eyes record soyoil imports amid sunflower oil disruption

India is projected to import a record quantity of soyoil due to disruptions in sunflower oil shipments caused by the Russia-Ukraine war. This situation has led to a significant increase in demand for soyoil as a substitute. The increased imports are expected to meet domestic demand for edible oils.
